title: Terapi Integration Connection
description: Schema for an integration connection in Terapi, representing an authenticated link between an end-user and a third-party service.

id.description: Your application's unique identifier for this connection (set by you)

provider_config_key.description: The integration provider configuration key this connection belongs to

provider.description: The third-party provider name (e.g., github, salesforce, slack, hubspot)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the connection was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the connection was last updated

metadata.description: Custom metadata stored with this connection (e.g., user ID, tenant ID)

credentials.description: Current credential status (no raw secrets are returned)

expires_at.description: Token expiration time for OAuth credentials
